prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
All deliverables verified on disk: result.json (253 words, 743 relations, most_connected palavra) cross-checks against words.json (253 entries, recomputed 743 pairs, max degree 16), and the 41 KB single-file universe/index.html renders the 3D word sphere with working search and ?word= deep links (confirmed live for both saudade and amor).

**[goal]** Sum the saved Portuguese creative dictionary into one browsable, shareable view.

**[action]** Parsed all 253 word pages in ./site (each has a word, a tema, and Sinônimos + Palavras análogas link lists), resolved hrefs (including URL-encoded ones like `fam%C3%ADlia.html`), dropped 21 dangling links to stub/removed pages (saudades, coracoes, rascunho-3, xpto-2…), and built ./universe/index.html: a three.js star-field where each word is a node (size/brightness by degree), edges are the 743 relations, with drag-to-rotate, scroll-zoom, click-to-select, a search box with suggestions, and a side panel showing the word's tema, synonyms and analogs. `?word=<w>` deep-links open that word highlighted with a halo and its relations panel.

**[result]**
- `./words.json` — 253 words → linked words.
- `./result.json` — `{"words": 253, "relations": 743, "most_connected": "palavra"}` (palavra and tempo tie at 16 links; palavra is the alphabetical first).
- `./universe/index.html` — single file, no build step; only external refs are Google Fonts and the exact three@0.170.0 module URL the brief allows.
- Verified live in browser: `?word=saudade` shows the sphere + panel (tema sentimentos; sinônimos ansiedade, carinho, dor, esperança, nostalgia; 5 ligações); `?word=amor` likewise (afeto, susto, tristeza / alma, árvore); search "mar" suggests mar, marinheiro.

**[next]** Assumptions stated: relations = union of the two link sections, deduped as undirected pairs; the three plural stub pages (saudades, coracoes, paixoes) and 7 removed-page links are excluded from the graph since they have no word pages; "most_connected" is by distinct linked words. Browser tabs closed; no processes left running.
